title: Fluor
summary: US engineering and construction group with nuclear and government services.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Fluor designs and builds large industrial facilities, including nuclear, LNG, mining and government projects, and provides site management and maintenance. Its nuclear experience spans government sites and commercial plant support. Fixed-price contracts and project execution have historically driven volatility.

Technology Exposure

  • Nuclear facility construction and support
  • Engineering and procurement
  • Government and industrial services

What To Watch

  • Contract awards
  • Project execution and cost overruns
  • Government budgets

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
